## Definitions

- [statement] Kraken's WebSocket FAQ says an OHLC update is not sent immediately after an interval boundary until the next trade occurs. (low confidence) — https://support.kraken.com/articles/360022326871-kraken-websocket-api-frequently-asked-questions

## How it works

- [statement] Coinbase Exchange warns that its WebSocket servers can receive market data in a way that results in dropped messages, despite TCP transport. (low confidence) — https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/exchange/websocket-feed/overview
- [statement] Pyth Core warns that outages can lead to stale price data. (low confidence) — https://docs.pyth.network/price-feeds/core/best-practices

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Coinbase Exchange documents per-product sequence gaps as indicators of dropped feed messages and lower sequence numbers as possible out-of-order arrivals. (low confidence) — https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/exchange/websocket-feed/overview
- [statement] Kraken's guidance for WebSocket v1 private order and trade feeds recommends comparing reconnect snapshot sequence numbers and reconstructing gaps using REST. (low confidence) — https://docs.kraken.com/exchange/guides/websockets/reconnection
- [statement] Apache Beam distinguishes event time from processing time and notes that events may arrive out of generation order. (low confidence) — https://beam.apache.org/documentation/programming-guide
- [statement] Pyth Core documentation says its SDK staleness threshold can be configured for the use case. (low confidence) — https://docs.pyth.network/price-feeds/core/best-practices
- [statement] Jupiter Price API V3 documentation says the response blockId can be used to verify price recency. (low confidence) — https://dev.jup.ag/docs/price
- [statement] Jupiter Price API V3 documentation says tokens without a reliable price are omitted from the response. (low confidence) — https://dev.jup.ag/docs/price
- [statement] Jupiter Price API V3 documentation says its token prices use the last swapped price across transactions. (low confidence) — https://dev.jup.ag/docs/price
- [statement] Pyth documentation says Hermes closes each stream after 24 hours and clients should reconnect. (low confidence) — https://docs.pyth.network/pro/use-prices-on-blockchain
- [statement] Pyth Pro documents that its JavaScript SDK reconnects dropped connections and removes duplicate messages. (low confidence) — https://docs.pyth.network/pro/subscribe-to-prices
- [statement] Coinbase Exchange warns that historical candle data may be incomplete and publishes no data for intervals with no ticks. (low confidence) — https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/api-reference/exchange-api/rest-api/products/get-product-candles
- [statement] Coinbase Advanced Trade candles documentation calls sequence_num a per-connection sequence number used to detect dropped or out-of-order messages. (low confidence) — https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/api-reference/advanced-trade-api/websocket/candles.md
- [statement] Coinbase Advanced Trade documents its candles channel as five-minute buckets updated every second. (low confidence) — https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/api-reference/advanced-trade-api/websocket/candles.md
- [statement] Jupiter Price API V3 says it uses heuristics while and after deriving the last swap price to filter outliers. (low confidence) — https://dev.jup.ag/docs/price
